content: openai_dart 8.1.0 (2026-08-27). Streaming SSE with explicit abortTrigger, custom baseUrl (documented for Azure and proxies), typed exception hierarchy ApiException/RateLimitException/OpenAIException. Changelog 8.1.0 shows deliberate OpenRouter reasoning_details round-trip support, evidence third-party OpenAI-compatible endpoints are a supported use case. 8.0.1 fixed Dart 3.13 LinkedHashMap multipart failure. Strict semver, MIT.
